top_signals.title: Imports and inventories stabilize in 2026, but for how long
top_signals.summary:
Container import activity has been steady throughout the summer with no sharp shifts in inventories. Recent history suggests that will change.

top_signals.title: Korea Tests Global Investor Appetite With Longer Trading Hours
top_signals.summary: South Korea’s main stock exchange is extending into evening sessions, breaking with Asia’s trading-hour norms to tap what it hopes will be sustained demand from global investors.
